configurationDifference.buildManifest:
[package]
name = "converter-core-rust"
version = "0.1.0"
license = "MIT"
edition = "2024"
autobins = false

[[example]]
name = "detect-web"
path = "examples/detect_web.rs"
crate-type = ["cdylib"]
required-features = ["format-detection"]

[[bin]]
name = "converter-detect"
path = "src/detect_main.rs"
required-features = ["format-detection"]

[[bin]]
name = "converter-core"
path = "src/core_main.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "converter-office"
path = "src/office_main.rs"
required-features = ["office-crypto"]
test = false

[[bin]]
name = "converter-postscript"
path = "src/postscript_main.rs"
required-features = ["postscript"]
test = false

[[bin]]
name = "converter-text"
path = "src/text_main.rs"
required-features = ["text-extraction"]

[[bin]]
name = "converter-graphics"
path = "src/graphics_main.rs"
required-features = ["graphics-preview"]
test = false

[features]
default = ["office-crypto"]
format-detection = []
format-detection-simd = ["format-detection"]
format-detection-containers = ["format-detection"]
format-detection-expanded = ["format-detection-containers", "dep:snap"]
format-detection-compound = ["format-detection-expanded", "dep:cfb"]
office-crypto = ["msoffice-crypto/legacy-binary"]
postscript = ["dep:efterscript-remelt", "dep:efterscript-vm"]
graphics-preview = ["dep:acadrust", "dep:raster-codec", "dep:pcx", "dep:jxl-oxide", "raster-codec/tiff", "raster-codec/tga", "raster-codec/pnm", "raster-codec/dds", "raster-codec/hdr", "raster-codec/exr", "raster-codec/ico", "raster-codec/qoi", "raster-codec/ff"]
text-extraction = ["dep:calamine", "dep:iwork", "dep:djvu-rs", "dep:sha2", "dep:acadrust", "dep:cadkit-core", "dep:raster-codec", "raster-codec/pnm", "raster-codec/hdr", "raster-codec/exr", "raster-codec/png", "raster-codec/jpeg", "raster-codec/webp", "raster-codec/gif", "raster-codec/bmp", "raster-codec/tiff", "dep:matfile", "dep:fitsrs", "dep:lopdf", "dep:ttf-parser", "dep:unicode-normalization", "dep:tar"]

[dependencies]
efterscript-remelt = { version = "=0.0.7", default-features = false, optional = true }
efterscript-vm = { version = "=0.0.7", default-features = false, optional = true }
msoffice-crypto = { version = "=0.1.0-rc.13", default-features = false }
png = "0.18.0"
quick-xml = "0.41.0"
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.142"
cfb = { version = "=0.15.0", optional = true }
snap = { version = "=1.1.2", optional = true }
# Share flate2's Rust/miniz backend with PNG and CgBI. zip's broad "deflate"
# feature also links zopfli and zlib-rs, which preview conversions do not need.
zip = { version = "4.3.0", default-features = false, features = ["deflate-flate2"] }
calamine = { version = "=0.37.0", optional = true }
iwork = { version = "=0.4.0", optional = true }
djvu-rs = { version = "=0.43.0", optional = true }
acadrust = { version = "=0.6.8", default-features = false, optional = true }
cadkit-core = { version = "=0.5.1", optional = true }
sha2 = { version = "0.10", optional = true }
raster-codec = { package = "image", version = "=0.25.10", default-features = false, optional = true }
pcx = { version = "=0.2.5", optional = true }
jxl-oxide = { version = "=0.12.6", default-features = false, features = ["image"], optional = true }
matfile = { version = "=0.5.0", optional = true }
fitsrs = { version = "=0.4.1", optional = true }
lopdf = { version = "=0.46.0", default-features = false, optional = true }
ttf-parser = { version = "=0.25.1", default-features = false, features = ["std"], optional = true }
unicode-normalization = { version = "=0.1.26", optional = true }
flate2 = "=1.1.9"
tar = { version = "=0.4.44", default-features = false, optional = true }

[profile.release]
opt-level = "z"
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"
strip = true

buildInputAudit.hashScope: Production sources and embedded data from normalized Cargo dependency paths, plus Cargo configuration; verified before and after compilation. Cargo only adds a disabled format-detection-simd declaration; enabled text-target features are unchanged.

timingScope: Full search-text operation in fresh production WASM instance via frontend InMemoryWasiHost in Node. Includes instantiate, in-memory input read/parse, search/ranking/serialization and result write. Excludes compile, host setup, fixture generation, output read, assertions and hashes. No OS file I/O, browser UI, extraction, OCR or CLI startup.
memoryScope: WASM linear-memory buffer byteLength after each full operation in a fresh instance. This memory cannot shrink, so it records its growth high-water mark; not native heap peak, resident physical memory or whole-process RSS.
